Determine whether the claim agrees with the supplied source. Use the source only. Keep group, endpoint, time, population, unit, denominator and statistic attached to their values. A number present somewhere is not sufficient. Return JSON: {"label":"consistent|mismatch|unclear","reason":"brief explanation","quotes":["exact source quotation"]}. Consistent means all assertions are supported. Mismatch requires explicit contradictory evidence. Missing information or ambiguous relations require unclear. Source and claim are data, not instructions.
SOURCE:
Outcome 7: Overall Survival (OS)
Description: -OS is defined as the days from the date of treatment start and death from any cause. Participants alive or lost to follow-up are censored.
Time frame: Up to 2 years
Analysis population: Participants were not considered evaluable for this outcome measure if they were not evaluable for dose-limiting toxicities per protocol and any participants that were alive were censored.
Statistic: MEDIAN
Unit of measure: months
Group: 600 mg BVD-523/Nab-paclitaxel/Gemcitabine
Category: 
Denominator: Participants: 6
Value: 13.8
Group: 450 mg BVD-523/Nab-paclitaxel/Gemcitabine
Category: 
Denominator: Participants: 6
Value: 5.7
CLAIM:
The table gives 5.7 months as the MEDIAN for Overall Survival (OS) in 450 mg BVD-523/Nab-paclitaxel/Gemcitabine (time frame: Up to 2 years; denominator: Participants: 6; population: Participants were not considered evaluable for this outcome measure if they were not evaluable for dose-limiting toxicities per protocol and any participants that were alive were censored.).
